name: playful-summer-tomato-cheeks
image_purpose: Casual social post and summer lifestyle content

prompt.project_info: Create a bright Instagram-style summer lifestyle photograph in a park, with a playful tomato-cheek gesture and a natural film-inspired finish.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult Asian woman with loose slightly messy braids, wearing an oversized white T-shirt dress, white knee-high socks, and light blue sneakers. A bright blue shoulder bag rests beside her. She crouches comfortably and holds two fresh red tomatoes against her cheeks with both hands, smiling softly.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical portrait from a very low ground-level angle, subject crouched on a park lawn and framed against a broad blue sky. Include soft trees and distant benches in the background, with the blue bag and red tomatoes as color accents.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright direct natural sunlight around midday or early afternoon, high-key airy exposure, clear face illumination, distinct but gentle shadows, warm golden highlights, subtle halation, and light film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm wide-angle look, f/5.6, moderate depth of field, Fujifilm Nostalgic Negative-inspired color, realistic skin texture, crisp subject, softened background, vertical social composition.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A bright playful vertical Instagram-style summer lifestyle photograph of one approved adult Asian woman with loose slightly messy braids, crouching comfortably on a park lawn and holding two fresh red tomatoes against her cheeks with both hands. She wears an oversized white T-shirt dress, white knee-high socks, light blue sneakers, and has a bright blue shoulder bag beside her. Very low ground-level 35mm perspective looking upward toward a broad blue sky, soft trees and distant benches, bright natural midday sunlight, airy high-key exposure, warm golden highlights, subtle halation, light film grain, Fujifilm Nostalgic Negative-inspired color, fresh candid cheerful mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, childlike appearance, dark gloomy lighting, formal wear, indoor setting, distorted hands, missing fingers, extra limbs, heavy makeup, watermark, random text, muted colors, cold clinical grading, harsh contrast, crushed shadows, excessive sharpness, heavy saturation, HDR, low resolution, blur
